$meta.title: Pointless coherence on glued carriers
$meta.purpose: Zoom-out index of a THEORY in construction (theory-shaped collection, TAXONOMY_SCHEMA.md 2026-10-16). Load first; follow detail pointers. Problems here are probes at a seam, not ends.
$meta.what_is_it: Which finitely additive two-valued states (states) on Dynkin carriers glued from window events are points, ideal points (ultrafilters on Omega), or pointless - and which shape of window graph decides it.
$meta.the_shape: Cycle x infinity is the seam. Cycle-only theory is owned (Vorob'ev/BFMY, sheaf contextuality, Kharoof-Ipek-Okay 2024 for cycle-scenario vertices). Infinity-only theory is owned (de Finetti, Howson 2008). No theory found treats finitely additive states on glued non-Boolean carriers. Data points so far: paths never pointless (hand); rings L>=4 pointless and sigma-forbidden (Lean); triangle open (sub-carrier evidence leans 'any cycle'). UPDATE 2026-10-16: triangle-free => locality (stars); forests => no pointless states; any induced cycle of length >= 4 => pointless states (transport). Open = chordal non-forest graphs, decided by the triangle. UPDATE 2026-10-17: TRIANGLE PROBE FIRED (a) - the triangle carries a pointless state (Lean, thm.triangle_pointless); with loops-travel + forests (hand): pointless <=> not a forest. Scope: pair windows over N (countably infinite alphabet). Over a finite alphabet every state is a point; a window covering the whole triangle makes the carrier Boolean.

$meta.stance: ANSWERS FIRST (adopted 2026-10-16). Primitive: questions + a state (consistent answer pattern); no answerer/substrate assumed. Derived: point / ideal point (reconstruction succeeds or fails). Pointless states = a region of the domain, not edge cases. Assumed: only the possibility space Omega (questions are sets of possibilities) - possibility assumed, actuality earned; Omega is scaffold, not ontology. Lean matches: FinAddState / LocalState are Val : Set Omega -> Prop with additivity, nothing more (SigmaEssentialWitness.lean). Gap: trichotomy (ideal point / flat / pointless) not yet a Lean predicate.

objects.name: glued carrier
objects.one_line: Possibility space Omega = X^V (assumed: what could be the case) with a family of two-element windows; window event = {x:(x_i,x_j) in A}, A arbitrary; carrier D = Dynkin closure of all window events.

objects.name: state (finitely additive two-valued)
objects.one_line: s: D -> {0,1}, s(Omega)=1, additive on disjoint pairs. Restricted to one window it is an ultrafilter u_k on X^2; adjacent u_k share marginals.

objects.name: point / ideal point / pointless
objects.one_line: A state is a point (delta_omega), an ideal point (s(E)=[E in W] for an ultrafilter W on Omega), or pointless (neither).

objects.name: ordered product p(x)p
objects.one_line: A in p(x)q iff {m:{n:(m,n) in A} in q} in p - 'draw m, then n later'. With p non-principal: {m<n} in p(x)p, marginals p, not symmetric.

objects.name: window graph
objects.one_line: Vertices = coordinates, edges = windows. Path, ring (L), triangle (L=3) are the instances studied; the theory's invariant should be a property of this graph.

objects.name: window family; flat / twisted (tentative)
objects.one_line: A state's window family = its ultrafilters u_k on the windows (compatible on shared coordinates). Flat = amalgamates to an ultrafilter on Omega; twisted (non-flat) otherwise. Working definition, the candidate central notion.

theorems.lean: TriangleCyclic.triangle_pointless_state, triangle_state_no_ultrafilter, triangle_state_no_point, triangle_has_pointless_state, sstar_window01, sstar_window12, sstar_window20
theorems.one_line: For every non-principal ultrafilter p on N, s* = W012 + W120 - W102 (signed combination of three iterated p-limit ultrafilters on N^3) is finitely additive, s*(Omega)=1, {0,1}-valued on the triangle carrier D3, and 1 on the staircase steps {x0<x1},{x1<x2},{x2<x0} (empty intersection), so no ultrafilter on Omega - in particular no point - reproduces it. Two-valuedness: if s*(E) is 2 or -1, ultrafilter Ramsey for triples gives an infinite P on which E follows its six-order profile; two box identities force the cyclic/anticyclic pattern; the homogeneous-set family is excluded from D3 by the lift lemma + Dynkin induction.
theorems.scope: Triangle over N, any non-principal p. That s* coincides with the forced functional Lambda on finitely built questions is hand (prop:forced). With thm.loops_travel (hand) and the forests theorem (hand): a window graph has a pointless state iff it is not a forest - that assembly is hand, not Lean. Scope: pair windows over N (countably infinite alphabet). Over a finite alphabet every state is a point; a window covering the whole triangle makes the carrier Boolean.

theorems.name: the cyclic set is not in the triangle carrier over N
theorems.status: proved, LEAN-CHECKED 2026-10-17 (formalization/staging/TriangleCyclic.lean: estar_not_mem, not_inF_of_mem; 0 sorry; axioms propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound); PRIOR ART: scout 2026-10-17 NOT FOUND (partial coverage; method folklore-adjacent via Keleti-Preiss)
theorems.lean: formalization/staging/TriangleCyclic.lean: TriangleCyclic.estar_not_mem, TriangleCyclic.not_inF_of_mem (D3 = DynkinSystem.generate of the three pair-window sigma-algebras on Fin 3 -> N, same construction as WindowGluing.glued)
theorems.one_line: Let B_n = {min pairwise gap <= n} and F = {Z: Z delta E* or Z delta E*^c lies in some B_n}. No member of F is in the Dynkin closure D over N; in particular E* is not in D. Lift lemma: if Z delta E* is in B_n and f has zero box interaction with f = 0 off Z, then f is constant on strict-cyclic points with gaps >= 2n+2 (box lifting the minimum far above the maximum; the other six corners are generic anticyclic). Least-stage argument: a complement stays in F; in a countable disjoint union exactly one piece takes the generic part and is an earlier member of F.
theorems.scope: E* family only (finite-band perturbations). Does NOT fire gate.triangle: sets with cyclic ultrafilter profile that differ from E* on a non-band p-small region are not covered.
theorems.detail: ../delay_embedding/collision_vs_generation.md (Triangle probe, Theorem E* is not in the carrier); verification/triangle_lift_lemma_check.py, triangle_offtie_atomicity.py

theorems.name: basic lemma
theorems.one_line: Proper differences stay in D; s monotone; s(A cap B)=1 when A,B,A cap B in D are true; s is an ideal point iff its true sets have the FIP. So pointlessness needs intersections D lacks.

theorems.name: sigma forces points (ring)
theorems.one_line: Over a countable alphabet every sigma-additive state on a glued pair-window carrier is a point (window Diracs agree; Dynkin uniqueness). Lean for the ring; hand for general window graphs. Finite alphabets: same with finite additivity.
theorems.scope: countable alphabet, any pair-window graph (Lean: ring only); fails for uncountable alphabets

theorems.name: staircase has no ideal point
theorems.one_line: u_k = p(x)p on every ring window: coherent on shared coordinates, every C_k true, but no ultrafilter on Omega (nor two-valued charge on the window-generated algebra) agrees, since the C_k have empty intersection.

theorems.name: countable pointless witness, every L>=4
theorems.one_line: The staircase window ultrafilters extend to a two-valued finitely additive state on the whole glued carrier D_L over N^L; it is pointless and has no sigma-additive version. No owner found after 3 prior-art passes.

theorems.name: literal irreducibility + six conjuncts (L=4)
theorems.one_line: The countable carrier D_4 has centre literally {empty, Omega} (the 'modulo countable' irreducibility is vacuous on countable Omega) and satisfies all six original admissibility conjuncts, Polish clause conditional on DWPolishCut as for the omega_1 witness.
theorems.detail: ../delay_embedding/collision_vs_generation.md (Third-pass prior-art gate, costume found and fixed)

theorems.name: locality: triangle-free (Helly windows) => star-sets
theorems.status: proved-hand; machine-checked on finite alphabets (D=G iff triangle-free on 8 graphs)
theorems.one_line: If the pair-window graph is triangle-free (windows a Helly family), every E in D is a disjoint union of window events on a star (windows sharing a common slot); states are determined by window ultrafilters, s(E)=sum u_w(E_w). Fails whenever there is a triangle.
theorems.scope: pair windows, triangle-free graph (trees, rings L>=4, bipartite graphs, ...)

theorems.name: ultrafilter amalgamation
theorems.one_line: Ultrafilters on XxY and YxZ with the same Y-marginal are the projections of one ultrafilter on XxYxZ (FIP argument).

owned_by.cite: folklore (ultrafilter / type amalgamation over trees); not located

theorems.name: no cycle, no pointless coherence (forests)
theorems.one_line: If the window graph is a forest, every state is an ideal point (tree amalgamation + locality).

theorems.name: ring state is forced; s<=1 by hand
theorems.one_line: On rings L>=4 any state equals u_{k-1}(E_{k-1})+u_k(E_k); it never exceeds 1 (local 3-coordinate amalgamation). Remaining Lean content of mu_cases = global well-definedness + additivity. Weakens the hub's 'all novelty in mu_cases' rebuttal.

theorems.name: C_0 cap C_1 not in the ring carrier
theorems.one_line: {x_0<x_1<x_2} is not in D_L (its slice at x_1=c is not a cylinder): the missing intersection that thm.basic says pointlessness needs.
theorems.detail: pointless_coherence.tex (The shape of the carrier, consequence)

theorems.name: finite alphabet: every state is a point
theorems.one_line: With a finite alphabet each window is a full power set, so states are points on windows and, by Dynkin uniqueness, everywhere. Pointlessness needs infinite alphabets; finite tests of the full carrier are uninformative.

theorems.name: ideal point iff flat window family
theorems.one_line: On window graphs satisfying the shape lemma, a state is an ideal point iff its window family is flat; so pointless states = non-flat families passing the extension test.

theorems.name: loops travel: induced cycles carry pointless states
theorems.one_line: If the window graph has an induced (chordless) cycle of length L>=4, pull back the ring-L staircase along psi (copy cycle coords, others constant): a pointless state over N with no sigma-additive version. Same transport: if the triangle carries one, every graph with a triangle does.
theorems.detail: pointless_coherence.tex (Theorem 'loops travel'; section 'Why loops', paragraph 'Loops travel')
theorems.scope: pair windows, countable alphabet; any graph with an induced cycle of length >= 4 (non-chordal)
theorems.lean_note: analogous cycle-map transport is Lean (pullback, sL_sigmaEssential); graph form not yet in Lean

theorems.name: extensions are forced on finitely built questions
theorems.one_line: Every buildable question has indicator f0+f1+f2 (window functions). On a triangle (and cycles) zero-sum triples are coboundaries + constants, so Lambda(f)=sum_k lim_{u_k} f_k is well defined for any compatible family; any extending state equals Lambda on finitely built questions. A family extends only if Lambda is {0,1}-valued there.
theorems.scope: triangle and cycles; finitely built questions only

theorems.name: cut-the-loop decomposition: Lambda = ideal building + one-window twist
theorems.one_line: For any window k: Lambda(E) = W^(k)(E) + delta_k(E), W^(k) the ultrafilter gluing the other windows (cycle cut at k), delta_k(E) = commutator of iterated p-limits of E's window-k part (gauge-invariant, linear). So Lambda is 0/1 on any E twist-free on some window; failure needs same-sign twist on all windows. Twist = non-commutativity of p(x)p, made precise; W^(j)-W^(k) = delta_k - delta_j (cocycle).
theorems.scope: triangle and rings; finitely built questions

theorems.name: rings: conceptual proof of the witness
theorems.status: proved-hand (agrees with Lean; not cross-checked line by line)
theorems.one_line: For L>=4, Lambda is a two-valued finitely additive state on the whole ring carrier: locality puts every question on two adjacent windows; cut at an untouched window m, so Lambda(E)=W^(m)(E) in {0,1}; Lambda linear. Explains (does not replace) the mu_cases case analysis; Lean remains the certificate; inherits the hand locality theorem.

conjectures.name: dichotomy = forest vs not
conjectures.one_line: Pointless states exist iff the window graph is not a forest. Holds iff the triangle carries a pointless state (then every graph with a cycle does, by thm.loops_travel).

conjectures.name: dichotomy = chordal vs not
conjectures.one_line: Pointless states exist iff the window graph is not chordal (has an induced cycle of length >= 4). The 'if' direction is proved (thm.loops_travel); the 'only if' needs chordal graphs with triangles to have none. Expected if the triangle has none.

conjectures.name: forests: never pointless
conjectures.one_line: Proved: forests never pointless, via triangle-free locality (stars) + tree amalgamation.

conjectures.name: target structure theorem
conjectures.one_line: Pointless states correspond to non-flat compatible window families passing the extension test, with non-flatness measured by a first-cohomology-like invariant of the window graph, coefficients in ultrafilter orders (winding). Target, not a claim. FIRST CONCRETE FORM 2026-10-16: twist delta_k = commutator of iterated ultrafilter limits on window k; moving the cut changes W by delta differences (cocycle) - see obs.cut_the_loop.

conjectures.name: windows of 3+ coordinates
conjectures.one_line: Rigidity weakens when non-adjacent windows overlap; what replaces 'acyclic' (Vorob'ev regularity?).

conjectures.name: Deligne-type completeness as the lens
conjectures.one_line: Deligne (SGA4): coherent toposes have enough points (= completeness for coherent logic, Makkai-Reyes). Is pointless coherence a failure of a Deligne-type theorem for probabilistic coherence? Raised 2026-10-16, no source read.

conjectures.name: which non-flat families extend
conjectures.one_line: Which non-flat compatible window families extend to a state on the whole carrier? The staircase does (Lean). Does every non-flat family on a ring L>=4?

conjectures.name: abstract carriers (answers first all the way down)
conjectures.one_line: Drop Omega: carriers as abstract question structures (orthoposets / test spaces); a state is representable if some concrete set representation makes it a point or ideal point. Does pointlessness survive with no background space? Stance owned (Foulis-Randall); classification would be new.

conjectures.name: Helly lens via Berge duality + BFMY
conjectures.one_line: If the dual of the hypergraph of true questions is alpha-acyclic (conformal + chordal), pairwise intersection upgrades to the FIP, so the state is an ideal point. Would import BFMY/Vorob'ev machinery; candidate route to the forest case and beyond. REALISED differently: the useful Helly property is of the WINDOWS (triangle-free = Helly for pair windows), giving locality (thm.shape_lemma) and the forests theorem.

conjectures.name: nerve of true questions as the twist invariant
conjectures.one_line: Nerve of the true window questions: die = K4 graph (Helly fails at 3), staircase L = boundary of a simplex S^{L-2} (fails at L), triangle = S^1. Reads twist consistently but does NOT decide extension. Transfer candidates: topological Helly (Kalai-Meshulam Leray numbers; Colin de Verdiere-Ginot-Goaoc). Compare with the Abramsky-Mansfield-Barbosa Cech obstruction before claiming.

conjectures.name: triangle twist lemma
conjectures.one_line: PROVED: Lambda in {0,1} on every finitely built triangle question. Profiles over the 6 drawing-order ultrafilters W_pi are constant or 'pair i before j' (closed under complement and disjoint union); Lambda = W^(k)+W^(j)-W^(jk) is 2 only on the 'staircase cyclic orientation' profile, which is not a pair condition. Open: countably built questions.

conjectures.name: is the cyclic-orientation set in the triangle carrier over N?
conjectures.status: E* PART SETTLED 2026-10-17: E* is NOT in D (thm.triangle_estar_not_built, hand). Open remainder: other cyclic-profile sets (non-band, p-small perturbations).
conjectures.one_line: E* = {[x0<=x1]+[x1<x2]+[x2<x0]=2} lies in the span of window functions and has the cyclic profile, so it is not finitely built (six-orders). If no cyclic-profile set is in the Dynkin closure over N, s* is a pointless triangle state (gate (a)). If E* is in it (via countable unions), s* fails and the question moves to other extensions. Prior-art target: Dynkin (lambda-) systems generated by unions of sigma-algebras / sums of sigma-algebras. Scout 2026-10-16: no characterization found; closest = sigma-class integral-additivity school (Navara, Ptak, Gudder, Dravecky-Sipos); method template Keleti-Preiss. Next reads: Keleti-Preiss, Ptak-Pulmannova (shelf), Navara 1984/1989. NAVARA LINK: E*^c is Navara's two-of-three set K(a,b) for f=x1-x0, g=x2-x1 (Math. Slovaca 34 (1984)); his Lemma-1 chains decide membership from a one-sided-bounded base case, absent here; the question is whether a countable chain / monotone limit reaches one. ATOMICITY 2026-10-17 (finite checks + HAND sketch): E* is V-atomic - any zero-triple-interaction subset of E* is empty or E* (all integer boxes up to 8^3; definable carriers T=0,1, where the only finitely built subset of E* is empty). So E* can enter the carrier only as a complement. Its complement is NOT atomic (it contains the tie window events {x1=x2=c}, {x0=x2=c}); switching tie convention swaps the sides. Proof plan: OFF-TIE LEMMA (each of strict-cyclic, strict-anticyclic is atomic off the tie set, ties free) + least-rank argument over the family {cyclic or anticyclic mod ties} => no member in D, so E* not in D. OFF-TIE LEMMA RAN 2026-10-17 and FAILS at finite boxes (ties free => restricted rank 3 at M=3, all 12 strict points separate at M=4; finite-box evidence, not a refutation on N^3): it freed too much. SUPERSEDED by gate.triangle_thin_atomicity (L = window cells inside E*^c, hand-checked: {x1=x2}, {x0=x2}, {x0=x1+1}; E* contains no window cell). Scope: excludes the E* family only, not every cyclic-profile set.

conjectures.name: dynamics on impossible figures (SEED, parked until the triangle line settles)
conjectures.status: PARKED 2026-10-17 (user approved). Banked: locality with infinitely many slots, degeneracy lemma, slogan 'the twist lives in the loop, not the action'. Re-open only via finitely additive regularity (invariant charges with a measurability condition; Bhaskara Rao unread). Record: both probes fired; degeneracy lemma (hand): invariant ideal point exists iff the window family lives on the diagonal, so invariance detects motion not impossibility; the twist lives in the loop of the window graph, not in the group action; the regularity (measurable-height) version is owned (Anosov/Gottschalk-Hedlund/Schmidt). Earlier: seed ACTIVE (triangle settled): impossible_dynamics_seed.md; hand observations H1-H4 (invariant state on the Escher frieze via ring pullback; no invariant ultrafilter by Katetov; sigma-stationary impossible; circle eigenvalue) UNVERIFIED; owned-region scout 2026-10-17: PARTLY OWNED (Penrose H1, Katetov partition + folklore no-invariant-ultrafilter, Gottschalk-Hedlund, Anosov, Okay-Raussendorf, AMB sheaf H1, invariant means/Tarski), core NOT FOUND (invariant two-valued states on glued carriers with no invariant ideal point); snippets only; probes gate.dynamics_frieze_periodic, gate.dynamics_circle
conjectures.one_line: Replace the loop by an ergodic process: charts glued by a cocycle (height increment per step). Impossible = the cocycle is not a coboundary (no global height section; Penrose 1992 reads impossible figures as nonzero Cech H^1, cited from memory, not shelved). Expected trichotomy: point = coboundary / global section; sigma-additive invariant state obstructed (translation holonomy has no invariant probability); finitely additive invariant means exist iff no paradoxical decomposition (Tarski) = amenability, the analogue of the ultrafilter states. Seam guess: Penrose cohomology x amenability/cocycle ergodic theory. Hostile prior-art FIRST: Schmidt 1977 cocycles, Mackey range, essential values, Kesten.

probes.evidence: NECESSARY CONDITION HOLDS (2026-10-16). Any extension must equal the forced functional Lambda(f)=sum_k lim_{u_k} f_k on finitely built questions (well defined: zero-sum window triples are coboundaries + constants). Lambda is {0,1}-valued on all definable finitely built triangle questions: T=0 430 sets, T=1 74,738 sets, 0 bad (verification/triangle_forced_functional.py). The ring-sweep's L=3 failure is on a non-buildable 0/1 function. Untested: countably built questions (value not forced by finite additivity). The earlier 'not point-Helly' downgrade was over-corrected: the oracle tested forced values, not an arbitrary finite state. Refutation hunt 2026-10-16 (triangle_lambda_hunt.py, 20 min/level): none at T=2,3,4 (~0.5M buildable questions each, ~250k true). UPDATE: the finitely-built necessary condition is now PROVED (six-orders argument); the gate turns entirely on countably built questions. Verified on carriers: profiles constant/half and the three-building identity hold on all T=0 (430) and T=1 (74,738) sets. probes.investigation: Does any set in the ternary triangle carrier (A=3, 15,914 sets) contain all three rotations (0,1,2),(1,2,0),(2,0,1) and none of the reversals (0,2,1),(1,0,2),(2,1,0)?

outcomes.then: no set of the triangle carrier over N has a bad profile (box-restriction transfer), so Lambda = s* is a pointless state on the triangle, in ZFC, for any non-principal p; by loops-travel, pointless <=> not a forest; gate.triangle fires (a)
inconclusive at the 3-box; escalate to a 4-box search; the construction tree is a candidate to lift to N

fired.result: 612 of 15,914 ternary carrier sets have the rotations-in/reversals-out footprint, including E* = {[x0<=x1]+[x1<x2]+[x2<x0]=2}. Moreover the A=3 carrier equals ALL 0/1 functions in the span of window functions (15,914 = 15,914), so finite boxes cannot decide the triangle at all: the gap between buildable and span-allowed exists only at infinity.

Triangle pointless: thm.triangle_pointless (Lean). Assembled with loops-travel and forests (hand): pointless <=> not a forest. Scope: pair windows over N (countably infinite alphabet). Over a finite alphabet every state is a point; a window covering the whole triangle makes the carrier Boolean. examples.name: six points, pointless but harmless
examples.one_line: Omega={1..6}, M1={1,2,3}, M2={3,4,5}, M3={5,6,1}, M4={2,4,6}: carrier {0,Omega,M_i,M_i^c}; s(M_i)=0 is a non-point state, automatically sigma-additive (finite).

examples.name: binary triangle: 'are all three equal?'
examples.one_line: Binary triangle carrier has 70 sets; the 4 beyond adjacent-pair unions are {000,111},{011,100},{001,110},{010,101} - each the complement of a union of window events, not one itself.

examples.name: ternary triangle: genuinely loop-only questions
examples.one_line: Ternary triangle carrier: 15,914 sets; 'all equal' is NOT in it; 2,088 sets with neither E nor its complement a union of window events; simplest is a 9-point cyclic step pattern mod 3.

owned_regions.name: sigma-additive pointless two-valued states on a union sigma-class of pairwise-meeting observables
owned_regions.one_line: If all nonempty preimages of f, g, f+g pairwise meet, A_f u A_g u A_{f+g} is already a sigma-class, carrying sigma-additive non-point two-valued states. Applies to the flight functions d0, d1 (d0+d1 = -d2) on N^3: a sub-carrier of the triangle carrier. These states do NOT extend to D3 (sigma-additive two-valued states on D3 are Dirac on each window and glue to a point; generator uniqueness). The triangle theorem's content is extension of a pointless state to the full lambda-closure, necessarily finitely additive.

owned_by.region: pointless sigma-additive states on the flight sub-carrier

owned_regions.name: explicit sigma-class C_{f,g} with a one-sided-bounded generator
owned_regions.one_line: Navara's Lemma 1-3 chains describe C_{f,g} (e.g. on Z x N0: A_f u A_g u A_{f+g} u K u K* u L u L*) and concentration of two-valued sigma-additive states, when one generator is bounded on one side. The triangle sits exactly in the regime with no base case (two-sided unbounded differences).

owned_by.cite: Navara, Math. Slovaca 34 (1984), Theorem and Lemmas 1-3
owned_by.region: C_{f,g} membership with a bounded generator

owned_regions.name: extendability of finitely additive states on Dynkin systems
owned_regions.one_line: A finitely additive state on a Dynkin system extends to the power set iff it is coherent. For two-valued states: ideal point = coherent/extendable; pointless = non-coherent. Standard names to use: point = concentrated (Dirac) state; ideal point = coherent state; pointless = non-coherent two-valued state; glued carrier = sigma-class generated by coordinate sub-sigma-algebras; window graph = marginal scheme / measurement cover.

owned_by.cite: Bhaskara Rao & Bhaskara Rao, Theory of Charges (1983) Thm 3.2.10; via Derr-Williamson arXiv:2302.03522

owned_regions.name: sigma-classes and additivity of the Gudder integral
owned_regions.one_line: Czech/Slovak sigma-class school: two-valued states on sigma-classes generated by observables f, g, f+g; additivity of the integral holds for finitely valued observables (Navara-Ptak 1983 Thm 2) and can fail for integer-valued ones (Dravecky-Sipos 1980). The triangle question is the three-generator, infinite-range case of this problem: Lambda two-valued on the generated class is additivity of the integral for f01+f12+f20. Navara-Ptak's six-point example (our sandwich shop) is literally their three-generator counterexample. No characterization of the generated class found; nothing decides E*.
